# Travel Around Japan

> > A comprehensive guide to traveling across Japan, featuring regional destinations, cultural attractions, transportation, and Japanese cuisine.

Travel Around Japan provides detailed guides to destinations across Japan's regions—from Hokkaido's lavender fields to Tohoku's samurai history sites. The site covers practical travel information including ekiben railway meals, ferry services, and postal services, alongside cultural attractions like historic castles, shrines, gardens, and museums.

## Key Topics

- Tohoku Region
- Fukushima Prefecture
- Hokkaido
- Kanagawa Prefecture
- Iwate Prefecture
- Aizu-Wakamatsu
- Samurai history
- Byakkotai
- Tsurugajo castle
- Japanese food
- Ekiben (railway boxed meals)
- Historical sites
- Tourist attractions
- Hot springs
- Meiji Restoration

## Fukushima & Aizu Region

- [Aizu-Wakamatsu city (Fukushima Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k26-07-aizu-wakamatsu.html): Aizu-Wakamatsu guide: Tsurugajo castle, samurai history & lacquerware
- [Mount Iimori [Iimoriyama] (Aizu-Wakamatsu city, Fukushima Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k26-07-05-iimoriyama.html): Mount Iimori historic site: Byakkotai samurai grave in Aizu-Wakamatsu
- [Oyakuen (Aizu-Wakamatsu city, Fukushima Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k26-07-02-oyakuen.html): Oyakuen Japanese garden: medicinal herb garden in Aizu-Wakamatsu
- [Hanamiyama Park (Fukushima city, Fukushima Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k26-01-02-hanamiyama.html): Hanamiyama Park: private flower farm on hill in Fukushima city

## Hokkaido Destinations

- [Furano city (Hokkaido)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k14-03-furano.html): Furano Hokkaido: lavender fields in summer & ski resort in winter
- [Obihiro Ban'ei Horse Racing (Obihiro city, Hokkaido)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k13-31-02-banei-keiba.html): Obihiro Ban'ei: world's only draft horse racing with heavy iron sleds
- [Nemuro city (Hokkaido)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k13-25-nemuro.html): Nemuro: easternmost Japan city, Cape Nosappu & earliest sunrise

## Iwate Prefecture Attractions

- [Geibikei gorge (Iwate Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k22-07-geibikei.html): Geibikei gorge: limestone cliffs & pleasure boat cruise near Ichinoseki
- [Kitayamazaki cliff (Iwate Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k22-09-04-kitayamazaki.html): Kitayamazaki cliff: 8km steep cliffs on Sanriku Coast with peaks
- [Fujiwara Heritage Park (Iwate Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k22-03-fujiwara-heritage-park.html): Fujiwara Heritage Park: historical TV drama set for samurai period
- [Tsuzuki-ishi rocks (Toono city, Iwate Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k22-08-07-tsuzuki-ishi.html): Tsuzuki-ishi megalith: mysterious ancient rock structure in Toono

## Kanagawa & Yokohama Area

- [Cupnoodles Museum (Yokohama city, Kanagawa Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k32-01-05-cupnoodle.html): Cupnoodles Museum Yokohama: instant ramen history & Ando Momofuku
- [Motomachi town (Yokohama city, Kanagawa Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k32-01-31-motomachi.html): Motomachi Yokohama: historic shopping district near Chinatown
- [Sasuke-Inari shrine (Kamakura city, Kanagawa Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k32-21-04-sasuke-inari.html): Sasuke-Inari shrine Kamakura: red torii gate tunnel & fox statues
- [Dobuita Street (Yokosuka city, Kanagawa Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k32-03-02-dobuita-dori.html): Dobuita Street Yokosuka: US Navy shopping area & sukajan birthplace

## Japanese Food & Cuisine

- [Bento (Boxed meal), Ekiben](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/j24-ekiben.html): Japanese bento & ekiben: railway station boxed meals for train travel
- [Japanese confections](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/j54-confectionery.html): Japanese wagashi confections: sweet bean paste & traditional treats

## Travel Essentials & Services

- [Water bus, Ferry](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/j16-ferry.html): Water bus & ferry services: Tokyo Sumida River & Miyajima cruises
- [Sending a letter, postcard from Japan](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/j26-mail.html): Japan Post guide: sending international air mail letters & postcards

## Optional

- [Oga Aquarium GAO (Oga Peninsula, Akita Prefecture)](https://www.travel-around-japan.com/k23-02-06-oga-aquarium.html): Oga Aquarium GAO: Sea of Japan marine life & hatahata fish display
